_comment: Activates brand-lint from the miragon-brand plugin (Claude Code hook, and the brand job in validate.yml for the docs site and README.md). designIQ's UI, docs and code are English, so the German-only copy rules are off, as in the CI's template for English repos: du (A1), umlauts (A3), German passive (A4), German claim (A7), gender forms (A11) and German UI texts (C5, a separate decision, see #238). Em dashes as connectors (A2), spellings (A10), the other copy hints (A5, A6, A8, A9), the anti-slop patterns (S*), palette, token and dark-mode rules stay on. Ignored: the docs kit in docs/.vitepress/miragon/ (vendored unchanged, linted at its source in Miragon/corporate-identity); the three notes in docs/ that are not site pages (srcExclude in docs/.vitepress/config.ts: the platform concept, the multi-repo gap analysis and the widget chrome spec the sources cite as 'spec §n'); process-documentation/ (the example content repo, mirrored to Miragon/process-documentation-starter); CHANGELOG.md (written by release-please); tests and their fixtures.
